facts.fact: Brandon Lee, Senior Manager in Platform Quality at StackAdapt, says his journey into adtech began in 2018 when he joined the company's Platform Quality team.
facts.quote: My journey into adtech began in 2018 when I joined StackAdapt’s Platform Quality team.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's Platform Quality team is responsible for reviewing programmatic campaigns before they are sent to supply partners and ultimately to the intended audience.
facts.quote: The Platform Quality team is responsible for reviewing programmatic campaigns before they are sent to our supply partners, and ultimately to the intended audience.

facts.fact: According to the page, the Platform Quality analyst role's original responsibilities included ensuring advertising campaigns met StackAdapt guidelines and that issues were identified and resolved promptly.
facts.quote: my responsibilities were to ensure that advertising campaigns met StackAdapt guidelines and that any issues were identified and resolved promptly.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'Life in Adtech: Helping StackAdapt users achieve their campaign goals' was published on April 25, 2023.
Brandon Lee graduated from the University of Guelph with a degree in marketing before working in a bank's fraud department.
facts.quote: After graduating from the University of Guelph with a degree in marketing, I picked up a full-time position as part of a bank’s fraud department.
